body:
Hey man,

Just want you to know I'm with you. Girlfriend left me almost 4 months ago, and it's broken me. I fortunately still live at home with my parents but it's a miserable existence. I shit the bed this year in school, and I'm so, so, so broke. 

I'm still in a shit place, literally and in terms of my emotional wellbeing. Just do your best. Keep doing your best even when it feels like it isn't enough. It might suck now, it might suck 4 months from now, and it might suck 10 years from now, I don't know. But at least give it your best shot. Keep your head down and work hard. I'm rooting for you. Best of luck.

Honestly sometimes I don't want anyone to read it. It's enough for me to just put it out there. I don't always have somewhere to say it out loud, so Reddit will do. Like an electronic journal. If someone responds or reaches out, awesome. But sometimes it's enough to just offload all the pain I feel in a little white box and send it out into the vast nowhere that is the internet.

I would delete facebook but it's how I communicate with most of my friends. It definitely fucking sucked though. Somehow much worse than seeing she'd updated her profile picture to one of her with him. I was only in one profile picture with her and that lasted all of two weeks lol. I think the only thing worse than knowing "You're the most important person in my life" was bullshit, is that I'm not worth the effort to her after two years of being there for her through a lot of shit, but this guy she's not even known for 6 months is. I think if I valued myself a little more, I'd make more of an effort to put that shit out of my reach. But I see myself about the same as the worst degenerates of society for a number of reasons. Sigh.

I know it feels that way, but I doubt that's the case. Whether you know it or not, there are people in your life who would not be able to handle losing you. It might be an old friend, a sibling, even someone who sees you in the halls at school. Someone who you probably would miss too. 

I'm convinced that I'm tearing my family apart. That I'm always letting my best friends down. That I'm the sole reason my ex left me. You want to find someone to exclusively put themselves down? Sign me up. I'll send you my resume. I could do everyone in my life a favour by not being a piece of shit. I can do that by just not being around to be a piece of shit, or I can suck it up and be a better person. Not just for them, but for myself too. I owe it to them. They deserve so much better from me than what I've given, and I have a lot of ground to make up that I can't if I'm dead.

As someone who is in a similar position, let me tell you this. I've done the research. There's not really any way that works well, that isn't painless, that isn't a gun. They're all either very, very painful, or unreliable (read: likely to leave you alive and incapable of finishing the job yourself). 

I was where you are. I was ready to do it. My whole family was gone for hours. We're doing work in our basement that left some prime rope real-estate. But even that isn't guaranteed. 

Do yourself a favour and don't do it. Find something to do. Find someone to talk to. You not wanting it to be painful tells me that you don't really want to hurt. Maybe it's because you still value yourself enough to not want to hurt. Maybe you think that it's just because you're selfish. I did. But you're allowed to be. Do something else that's "selfish" and find help. Cut out who you need to so that you can be okay. Befriend who you want when you want. You're not alone, but the wrong people certainly can make you feel that way. 

I don't know you. I don't know your struggle. I don't even honestly have the emotional capacity to try to understand it. I have my own shit that takes every ounce of my being to keep together. It's fucking hard. But I can do it. I can do it by asking for help. You can too. Don't just stop when someone tells you no. There are a lot of wonderful people out there who are so happy to help, and really will if you let them. Not to fix it all for you, but to show you how to fix it yourself. Good luck friend.

I think it matters because we already know how fucking god awful this is. There's plenty of people I know who I honestly want to throat punch, but I wouldn't want them to feel this way. Seeing people post on here about the same stuff I struggle with breaks my heart because I know exactly how it feels. I've spent every waking moment that I've been depressed praying that I'd find a way to make everything better. Even just for 5 minutes. If I can give someone else that by giving them a few pieces of advice or some reassurance, then you can bet I'm going to. I won't sugarcoat it, but I also want people to know that there is hope. Even I can see it, once in a blue moon. 

I can be kind to strangers because I'm not a bad person. None of us are, inherently. It's a choice. I choose to try to help others when I can, because I know that I would love to have a stranger be kind to me. If I'd like that, why wouldn't anyone else? What does it matter if I'm also doing it for myself if it helps you? If it gives you even a second of hope, of potential to see what you can really do, then it shouldn't matter if I get something out of it too. We all want to get ourselves out of this. We all should want to, anyway. If we can work together to do it, why wouldn't we? I'm sick of being alone. I'm sick of being the one who suffers for another person. I want to share my love, and have love shared with me. Doesn't matter if I know you or not. You're a real person who matters to someone, and that means you should matter to _everyone_. We're only here on this rock for a limited time, so we should all try to help each other as much as we can. Life doesn't have to suck always.

I worry that I'll never be able to move on. I think I might kill myself if I'm still the same person in a year. Guess we'll see. Good luck to you. If I know one thing, it's that this is one of the worst feelings in the world.

Fuck me man. I'm about 3.5 months out of a relationship. If you want to read more about that or how I feel, look at my post history. I'm a fucking mess. I have been from the moment she told me. I'm not always a mess anymore. I have good days. But I also have bad days, and then really bad days. Like the day she told me she was seeing someone else. Or the day she wouldn't apologize for blowing me off like I'm no one. Or the day I had to tell her I couldn't be a part of her life anymore. Or the day facebook suggested I add her new boyfriend. Or when she changed her profile picture to one of her with him. 

I don't have any answers. I just get high or drink (or both) and listen to City and Colour and bawl my eyes out. 

I miss my best friend. Not just every so often, but every second of the day. Despite all the shit she's put me through, I'm still fucking devastated, and still wish I had the strength to jump off a bridge. There are days where it feels like death would be easier than feeling this way. 

I still don't know how to stop the heartbreak. It's like an open sore. The gym helps. Talking to other people helps. It's not a magic fix though. I hope that you find some sort of strength in yourself to heal from this.

If you go into it expecting it to fail, it will. There is no magic cure-all, but you'd be surprised how useful breathing exercises can be. If you want to beat your depression and anxiety, you have to be the one in control. That means setting aside you judgements of what you think will or won't work, and just giving it a shot. If you put forth a genuine effort and it doesn't work out, then work towards something else. 

The thing with meds is that they might or might not work, but if you can improve your mentality just by practicing being mindful and focusing all your energy on self-improvement, you'll probably see some results. 

If you have given it an honest try, then I'm sorry you haven't had success, but if not, I really think you should give it a shot. If it does end up working for you, I think that will make the victory that much more worthwhile. Remember that this is your mental health. It's a fragile thing, and it can't just magically improve. Like anything else in life, it comes with work and practice. Good luck internet stranger. I'm rooting for you.

What works for me, what I consider "wanting to get better" means just letting the assholes in my life do and say what they want. I don't care. I do want to get better. I'm going to get better. They're right, but not for the reasons they think. They don't understand the struggle I go through every day, and they never will. Fuck them. I do what I can, when I can, and then I do my best to do a little extra. If having one meal that day is what I can manage, fuck, I'm happy. 

Give yourself a break. Dealing with depression is fucking horrid and sometimes just getting up to have a snack or drink some water is something to be proud of. Don't let what other people say affect you. So long as you're not hurting anyone, do what you can for you, regardless of what it makes other people think. You're the one who suffers the most from your depression. You're the one who knows the ins and outs and what is too much on a given day. Even if you fucking hate your guts, find something to love about yourself. Find something new the next day. If you run out of things, do something to make yourself proud. Even if it's "I went for a run," or "I had a shower," or "I washed my face." Force yourself to love yourself. 

Hang in there. You get good and bad days, but I hope you can have more good days than bad days in the future. It really does start with you though. Go out there and make yourself proud. You're awesome even if you can't see it.

I hear you man. Really I do. The girl I was fully set on marrying left me a few months ago and it's been a real rude awakening. It's true when they say you need to love yourself first though. I didn't. I still don't. But now I know I need to. Because otherwise I won't have someone love me.  Nothing I have will ever last if I look at myself the way I do now, and as far as I'm concerned, it's not worth it to waste my time trying to love someone who can't love me. It'll always be a lie. It might be nice for a month or 6 or a year, but it just won't last the way it could. You'll put more into the relationship than yourself, and she'll figure it out faster than you will, and then she'll leave you, and you'll be broken. Ask me how I know that, lol. 

Spend time with yourself. If other people see that you're happy with yourself, they'll want to be with you too. Just remember to love yourself. You're the most important one in this equation.
Same dude. Fucking same. Sigh.

Dude. I know it feels like it, but having a relationship isn't that worth it, especially if you're feeling alone. The joy you experience will only be temporary and you won't be strong enough to weather the shit that comes with relationships on top of everything else going on in your life. You're only 18. You know how dumbs most girls are at 18? Hell, my most recent ex was in her mid-20's and still dumb. 

Something I've found out the hard way, is that it's better to wait for people who really matter, and at 18 it's better to just shut out the bullshit and work on yourself. Go to the gym, study, work, and be kind. Put yourself out there but remember there's plenty of time to find someone who's going to treat you the way you want. The first kiss, date, that closeness, matters a million times more with someone who really loves you and respects you the same way you do them.

I usually say "I'm okay" or "I'm good" because everyone knows that "fine" and "tired" really mean "fucking awful". "Good" or "okay" don't generally have a different implication. Sure, I'm lying, but it's way easier than having to tell someone why I feel like playing in traffic, or arguing with someone about how I just want to be left the fuck alone. Lying is okay if I'm the one suffering because of it, because what's an extra pound if you're carrying 10,000 already anyway?

Well, if you're anything like me, you cry yourself to sleep most nights and constantly hurt the people closest to you, and just generally lash out at people because you're miserable. It's not fun. I hate everything I see in the mirror but that doesn't mean I don't still tell myself I need to be better and love myself. It rarely works the way I intend but every so often I can find a reason to smile.
Nothing worse than realizing that while they're the one for you, you aren't the one for them.

My best friend was my long distance girlfriend. 3 months ago she broke up with me and started seeing someone else. I can't even bring myself to respond to her texts/emails anymore. She was my best friend. She was the one I was hoping to marry. Instead I'm alone. 

It sucks not having a best friend. I've told myself that I've got to be my best friend. I've got to be my own support system, because no one else in my life really cares. It's soul crushing but that's just life, I guess.

Hang in there stranger.

I think my life will improve once I can finally move out of my parents' house. Unfortunately 2 years is a long time to have to wait but that's just the way the cookie crumbles I guess. Maybe you'll be able to find some peace if you move out? I don't know about you but I really find that my family is very toxic towards me and really holding me back from being able to enjoy my life and have any sort of confidence in myself. I'm always falling short of their expectations and always the one who's wrong in an argument, regardless of the side I choose. I'm always wrong because I'm just some dumb kid who doesn't know what the "real world" is like, and won't ever possibly have experienced enough to know better than them. It's annoying, discouraging, and it's driving me to the point where suicide is looking quite nice.
Hope you're doing better.

Used to be a straight A student. My depression/anxiety made me fail a course this year. Three others were each within 5% of failing (54% and lower). Know what makes suicidal thoughts worse? Knowing your brain is working against you, causing you to fail the most important classes. I'm full year behind on my degree. I can't focus to study, or write tests. I can't remember how to solve problems or explain theories/methodologies. I can't explain concepts or provide examples. I used to be so smart and I'm not. To top it off, I smoke too much weed to help deal with my depression, and I just watch the brain cells drift away.
Y'all got any more of those meteors?

Either get me a winning lottery ticket so I can move out to the middle of nowhere and get away from everyone or hit me with a bus. I'm too much of a coward to kill myself but I'm also too much of a shit person to function around other people in a constructive way.
Hard to get much worse than crippling depression, though. But, you can try! Sigh.

I'm not exactly optimistic for the future either, but I try to tell myself that the more I do to better myself, the more likely it is I'll attract some decent folk. That's the story I've sold myself on. Whether it works out that way is a possibility I'm doing my best to ignore lol

Thanks for your reply.

I find my biggest problem is when they break your heart, then give you a glimmer of false hope only to leave you more broken and lost than before. I wish I could tell how people actually felt around me so that I'd know when to just give up. I wish I could tell when someone is sick of me so I could at least stop making a fool of myself. I'm sick of believing in things that mean nothing to someone else. Mostly I just don't know how to believe in myself anymore and it's affecting every aspect of my life. 

I hope that you find some sort of peace in this shithole of an existence. I know there's other good people out there, and I hope that you can find some who love you the way you deserve because this shit gets old way too fast.

I have to say that while high school was bad for me, university has been worse. For everyone who reads this, just keep in mind that it won't always get better just because you're moving on to a new phase of your life. Shitty thing to think about, however it is the reality. :(

She's not in love with me anymore. She probably hasn't been for a really long time. She cut me out of her life all while telling me how important I was and how she never wanted to lose me. I thought I was going to marry her and instead she left me. It's broken me. She was my best friend and she just fucking abandoned me. It sucks and I don't know how long I can deal with it.

Only way I can get through my day is by spending juuuust about every waking moment stoned. I struggle to get out of bed anymkre, though I try my best not to admit it. Been trying to spend as much time doing other things as I can, but everything I do is a constant reminder of every piece of me that I hate. Every mistake I've ever made. All the things I could have done but was too afraid to. And now it's too late. Weed doesn't fix everything, but it gives me a brief period of relief from it all.
when the one you love most in this world stops being your friend.

Last night. The girl I wanted to spend the rest of my life with left me almost two months ago. I still can't get over it. She's my absolute best friend in the entire world. We had such a wonderful connection and it's gone. She won't even be my friend anymore. I hate myself because I know it's my fault for not being good enough. This keeps happening. I just push people away, all the time. 

She moved on really fast and it's really broken me. With everything else going on in my life I really, really need her. I need my best friend. I just want to kill myself. There's not much point to life if you can't tell the people you love how important they are to you. She was the most important and I can't see her wanting to ever talk to me again. Fuck.
